author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Russia-linked APT group Turla turned its Kazuar malware into a stealthy P2P botnet for long-term access to compromised systems. Russia-linked APT group Turla upgraded its Kazuar backdoor into a modular peer-to-peer botnet designed for stealth and persistent access to infected systems. author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: OpenAI said the TanStack supply chain attack compromised two employee devices and exposed credentials from code repositories. title: OpenAI hit by supply chain attack linked to malicious TanStack packages
